title: GDEPO: Group Dual-dynamic and Equal-right Advantage Policy Optimization for Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2601.06795v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automated Theorem Proving (ATP) is a fundamental AI challenge, requiring machine-verifiable proofs in formal languages like Lean to evaluate reasoning. Reinforcement Learning (RL), especially Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is a mainstream approach. However, GRPO faces two critical issues in ATP: its relative advantage estimation may conflict with binary verifier feedback under composite rewards, and its static sampling strategy discards batches without valid proofs, causing data waste. Repeated training on mastered problems also wastes computation. To address this, we propose Group Dual-dynamic and Equal-right Advantage Policy Optimization (GDEPO), incorporating three core mechanisms: 1) dynamic additional sampling, resampling ineffective batches until a valid proof is found; 2) equal-right advantage, decoupling the advantage function's sign (correctness) from its magnitude (auxiliary rewards) to ensure stable policy upda

translated_title: GDEPO：面向样本高效强化学习的组双动态与等权优势策略优化
translated_abstract: 自动定理证明（ATP）是一项基础性的人工智能挑战，需要在Lean等形式语言中生成机器可验证的证明来评估推理能力。强化学习（RL），特别是组相对策略优化（GRPO），是目前的主流方法。然而，GRPO在自动定理证明中面临两个关键问题：其一，在复合奖励下，其相对优势估计可能与二元验证器反馈发生冲突；其二，其静态采样策略会丢弃不含有效证明的批次，造成数据浪费；同时，对已掌握问题进行重复训练也会浪费计算资源。为解决这些问题，我们提出了组双动态与等权优势策略优化（GDEPO），包含三个核心机制：1）动态补充采样，对无效批次进行重采样，直到找到有效证明为止；2）等权优势，将优势函数的符号（正确性）与其幅值（辅助奖励）解耦，以确保稳定的策略更新……
tldr: 提出GDEPO方法，通过动态补充采样减少数据浪费，并通过将优势符号与辅助奖励幅值解耦的等权优势机制解决GRPO在自动定理证明中优势估计与验证反馈冲突的问题，实现样本高效的强化学习。
en_tdlr: GDEPO addresses GRPO's advantage estimation conflicts and data waste in automated theorem proving by introducing dynamic additional sampling and an equal-right advantage mechanism that decouples the advantage sign from auxiliary reward magnitude, enabling sample-efficient reinforcement learning.
